h2: Water Pumps & Filters Sanur – Reliable Supply for Older Villas
intro: Sanur's older villas and beachfront homes put extra strain on water systems, so Water Pumps & Filters Sanur work goes beyond a one-off fix here. I handle pressure switches, rooftop tanks, well-water filtration and the pipework connecting them all. If your supply has gone unreliable or your filter keeps clogging, send photos on WhatsApp for a quote.

sections.h3: Salt Air, Brackish Wells and Brittle Pipework
sections.text: In Sindhu and Semawang, the constant sea breeze corrodes pump motors, tap fittings and hinges long before they'd fail inland. Add brackish well water near the coast and you get filters that clog faster plus scale building up inside heaters. Many of these villas still run original PVC pipe that has turned brittle under years of sun; replacing a short section is usually smarter than patching over it.

sections.h3: Common Pump and Tank Problems Around Sanur Kaja
sections.text: The calls I see most often: a pump clicking on and off every few seconds (pressure switch issue), no water reaching upstairs rooms because the tank ran dry, an overflowing rooftop tank with a stuck float valve, or a whole-house filter needing new cartridges after months of brackish supply. If the problem started after a PDAM outage or a dry-season dip in well level, mention that when you message.

sections.h3: What to Send Me on WhatsApp for a Quote
sections.text: A short video of the pump running—or not—helps enormously, along with photos of the pressure switch, the tank's fill area, and any visible corrosion on fittings. Note whether you draw from a well or PDAM mains and roughly how old the pipework is. I'll review what you've sent and come back with a clear quote; pricing depends entirely on the job, so there's no fixed rate sheet to point you to.

sections.h3: Keeping Your System Running Between Visits
sections.text: Flush the filter housing monthly during dry season to slow scale buildup, and check your rooftop tank's float valve every couple of weeks so it doesn't overflow onto the roof. Keep pump motors shaded and covered where salt spray reaches them. If water pressure drops gradually over a week rather than failing suddenly, that's usually a developing seal issue—catching it early saves a full motor replacement down the road.

faq.q: Why does my well-water filter clog so fast near the beach?
faq.a: Brackish water carries more dissolved minerals and fine sediment than inland supply, so cartridges lose capacity quicker. Swapping to a higher-rated cartridge or adding a pre-sediment stage usually extends life noticeably.

faq.q: My pump keeps switching on and off every ten seconds. Is it dangerous?
faq.a: It's not an immediate safety risk but will burn out the motor within weeks. In most Sanur villas the cause is a worn pressure-switch diaphragm or air trapped in the line; I can sort both from photos of the unit.

faq.q: Do I need a whole-house filter if I already have PDAM mains?
faq.a: PDAM water still picks up iron and sediment through ageing distribution pipes, especially in older estates like Sanur Kaja. A basic sediment-plus-carbon setup protects your heater, washing machine and taps with minimal upkeep.
